# LeakSanitizer suppressions for lchash CI.
#
# Format: "leak:<substring>", where the substring must appear in some
# frame of the leak's stack trace.
#
# No entries yet: the ASan CI job hasn't reported any process-lifetime
# allocations. Add narrow entries for known-good leaks (for example,
# vendored-library MINIT singletons) instead of setting
# detect_leaks=0 in .github/workflows/tests.yml.
#
# To audit a new leak locally:
#   ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 LSAN_OPTIONS=fast_unwind_on_malloc=0 \
#     <asan-php> -d extension=lchash.so -r '<repro>'
